info.title: Tikway Gemini API
info.description: Gemini-compatible content generation and cached content APIs through the Tikway gateway.

schema.description: Create a request body for cached content. The cached content is preprocessed and can be reused in subsequent build requests. The cache can only be used for the model specified when it was created.

contents.description: A list of content that needs to be cached. It can contain a single round of content, or it can contain multiple historical rounds of content in dialogue order. This field is for input only and cannot be modified after the cache is created.

items.description: A piece of dialogue consisting of a character and one or more content parts.

role.description: The role the content belongs to. user represents user content, and model represents historical content generated by the model.

parts.description: A list of parts that make up the current content. Each Part can represent text, inline files, uploaded files, function calls, function responses, or code execution information.

items.description: an integral part of the content. text, inlineData, fileData, functionCall, functionResponse, executableCode, codeExecutionResult usually only one of them is set.

inlineData.description: To embed binary data directly in the request, the data needs to be Base64 encoded.

mimeType.description: MIME type for inline data, such as text/plain, image/jpeg, application/pdf.

displayName.description: The display name of the inline media.

fileData.description: File reference obtained after uploading via Gemini File API.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the referenced file, such as text/plain, image/jpeg, application/pdf.

fileUri.description: File URI returned by the File API.

displayName.description: The display name of the file.

functionCall.description: Function call information generated by the model in historical conversations.

name.description: The name of the function to be called should be consistent with the function name declared in tools.functionDeclarations.

args.description: The parameters used when calling the function, the structure is determined by the parameters JSON Schema of the corresponding function.

functionResponse.description: The result returned to the model after the client executes the function.

name.description: The name of the executed function should be consistent with the corresponding functionCall.name.

response.description: Function execution result. Can contain data, status, or error information returned by the function.

executableCode.description: Code generated by the model that can be run by the code execution environment.

language.description: The programming language used by the code. LANGUAGE_UNSPECIFIED means unspecified, PYTHON means Python.

code.description: The source code needs to be executed.

codeExecutionResult.description: The execution results returned by the code execution environment.

outcome.description: Code execution status. OUTCOME_OK indicates success, OUTCOME_FAILED indicates failure, and OUTCOME_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED indicates execution timeout.

output.description: Standard output, error messages, or other textual results produced by code execution.

thought.description: Indicates whether the current Part belongs to the thinking content of the model. Usually generated by the server, the original value should be maintained when returning historical content.

thoughtSignature.description: A signature of what the model thinks about. The historical content of the model should be kept intact when returned and should not be modified or generated by the client.

partMetadata.description: Custom metadata associated with the content block.

mediaResolution.description: The resolution of this media content block.

toolCall.description: Server-side tool calls that need to be returned by the client.

toolResponse.description: The execution result of the server tool call.

tools.description: A list of tools that the model can use when subsequently generating content. This field is for input only and cannot be modified after the cache is created.

items.description: A tool statement. You can declare client functions, code execution tools, or other tools supported by the model.

functionDeclarations.description: A list of function declarations provided by the client for use by the model.

items.description: A function definition that can be called by the model.

name.description: function name. The name should be unique and comply with the naming rules supported by the server.

description.description: Function usage and calling scenario description, the model will determine whether to call the function based on this description.

parameters.description: JSON Schema of function parameters. Usually the type of the root node is object, and the parameters are declared through properties.

response.description: JSON Schema of the function return value, used to describe the structure of the function execution result.

behavior.description: How the function call is executed.

parametersJsonSchema.description: JSON Schema of function parameters; mutually exclusive with parameters .

responseJsonSchema.description: JSON Schema of the function response; mutually exclusive with response .

codeExecution.description: Enable model code execution capabilities. The current configuration object is usually empty.

expireTime.description: Absolute time of cache expiration, using RFC 3339 format. The server output will be normalized to UTC time. This field is mutually exclusive with ttl, at most one of them can be set.

ttl.description: The relative validity period of the cache, in seconds, supports up to 9 decimal places, and ends with s. This field is for input only and is mutually exclusive with expireTime.

displayName.description: A human-readable name set by the user for the cached content, containing up to 128 Unicode characters. This field cannot be modified after the cache is created.

model.description: The name of the model resource used to create and use this cache. The cache can only be used for the models specified here, in the format models/{model}. This field is required and cannot be modified after creation.

systemInstruction.description: System commands set by the developer. Currently only plain text Parts are supported. This field is for input only and cannot be modified after the cache is created.

role.description: The role of the system command content. This field can usually be omitted.

parts.description: List of text parts that make up a system command.

items.description: A text section in a system command.

text.description: System command text that defines a model's identity, behavior, task requirements, or output rules.

toolConfig.description: Tool call configuration. This configuration is shared by all tools and is only used for input. The cache cannot be modified after it is created.

mode.description: Function calling pattern. MODE_UNSPECIFIED means unspecified and not recommended; AUTO means the model can return text or call a function at its discretion; ANY means the model must call a function; NONE means function calls are prohibited; VALIDATED means the model can return text or call a constraint-validated function.

allowedFunctionNames.description: A list of function names that the model is allowed to call. Should only be set when mode is ANY or VALIDATED, and the name must match the function name in functionDeclarations.

items.description: Function names that are allowed to be called.

retrievalConfig.description: Retrieves the context configuration used by the tool.

latLng.description: The latitude and longitude of the user's location follows the WGS84 coordinate standard.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, ranging from -90 to 90.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, ranging from -180 to 180.

languageCode.description: The language code used for user content should use BCP 47 language tags, such as zh-CN, en-US.

includeServerSideToolInvocations.description: Whether to include the server tool call and its response in the Content of the model response. After setting to true, the client can observe the calling process of the server tool.

parts.text: You are a creative bedtime-story assistant. Keep stories gentle and suitable for children.
Reference material: Unicorns are magical horses with a single horn. They live in enchanted forests and help kind-hearted people.

schema.description: The cached content resource returned after successful creation. The response mainly contains cache identification, model, creation time, update time, actual expiration time and token usage.

name.description: The unique resource name of cached content, generated by the server, in the format cachedContents/{id}.

displayName.description: The human-readable name set when creating the cache. This field may not be returned when not set.

model.description: The name of the model resource bound to this cache. Caching can only be used with this model.

createTime.description: The creation time of the cached resource, generated by the server, in RFC 3339 format and usually normalized to UTC time.

updateTime.description: The time when the cached resource was last updated, generated by the server, in RFC 3339 format and usually normalized to UTC time.

expireTime.description: The absolute time at which the cache actually expires. Regardless of whether expireTime or ttl is used in the request, the server will return this field in the response.

usageMetadata.description: Token usage information for cached content.

totalTokenCount.description: The total number of tokens currently occupied by cached content.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Cache content ID, corresponding to resource name cachedContents/{id}.

parameters.description: Cache content ID, corresponding to resource name cachedContents/{id}.

geminiApiKey.description: Tikway API Key. Passed through the x-goog-api-key request header according to the Gemini native protocol.
